catalogue_metadata.scope_notes: Analysis covers core Python modules in cas_runner, governance engines, health models, and dashboard infrastructure while strictly excluding agentic prompt/LLM-orchestration mechanics.
analysis_limits: Repository source files were reviewed based on file structure manifests and key file exports.
Agentic-specific workflow specifications (e.g. speckit agent skills) were omitted in accordance with focus constraints.

system_map.overview: cas_runner provides automated architectural governance, compliance verification, and health projection for software systems. It follows a multi-tier architectural style comprising a CLI/Runner execution layer, an application service/engine layer, a domain entity model, and an infrastructure adapter layer integrating static site generation (MkDocs) and external service clients.

patterns.name: Pydantic Domain Entity & Metric Modeling
patterns.summary: Encapsulates architectural governance data, metrics, and health states within strongly typed, schema-validated Pydantic domain models.
patterns.intent: Ensure schema integrity, runtime type-safety, and seamless serialization across system boundaries for all governance assets.
patterns.context: Governance audits produce structured findings, metrics, and risk assessments that must be serialized to reports or consumed by compliance engines without type ambiguity.
forces: Runtime safety across non-typed data feeds (YAML/JSON)
Strict contract enforcement without extensive boilerplate validation logic
patterns.solution: Define domain models using Pydantic BaseModel, providing validation, immutability where applicable, and standardized serializability.
implementation_signals: Composition of Metric and Finding sub-models

evidence.note: Complete domain object aggregate defining the health, compliance, and metric entities of the governance system.

benefits: Eliminates parsing ambiguities between serialized file states and memory structures.
Clear boundary definitions for compliance reporting.
costs: Introduces dependency on Pydantic v2 core.
Serialization overhead when operating over very large metric collections.
failure_modes: ValidationError exceptions crash pipelines if schemas evolve without backwards compatibility.

patterns.reuse_notes: Reusable across any architecture governance platform processing YAML/JSON steering files.

patterns.name: Transition Registry State Machine
patterns.summary: Decouples lifecycle state transition execution from action handling using a dedicated transition registry.
patterns.intent: Manage discrete states and valid operational transitions for governance actions through an explicit registry instead of hardcoded conditional logic.
patterns.context: Governance action items transition through states (e.g., proposed, approved, rejected, resolved) requiring specific operational constraints and side effects.
forces: Extensibility for new transition rules without modifying core engine flow
Centralized validation of valid state progression
patterns.solution: Implement a TransitionRegistry that indexes permissible transitions and delegates handling to specialized action processors within GovernanceActionEngine.
implementation_signals: Registry class mapping source and target states
Engine dispatching actions based on registered transition handlers

evidence.note: TransitionRegistry governs state validity; GovernanceActionEngine coordinates dispatch.

benefits: Simplifies unit testing of individual state transition handlers.
costs: Additional indirection layer compared to simple procedural state updates.
failure_modes: Unregistered states cause silent drop or unhandled transition exceptions.

patterns.reuse_notes: Can be applied to any lifecycle-driven entity tracking workflow approvals or architectural changes.

patterns.name: Pure Functional Health Evaluation
patterns.summary: Evaluates architectural and repository health status using side-effect-free, deterministic calculation functions.
patterns.intent: Provide consistent, easily testable health score and status derivations without coupling to database, file system, or network states.
patterns.context: Health dashboards require unambiguous status calculation (e.g. GREEN, YELLOW, RED) along with transparent human-readable explanations based on input metrics.
forces: Calculation must be strictly reproducible given identical metrics
Diagnostic reasoning must accompany health score changes
patterns.solution: Isolate health calculation into pure functions that accept domain metrics and return typed status enums and diagnostic reason lists.
implementation_signals: Top-level calculation functions without global state mutation
Dual functions for score derivation and diagnostic reason extraction

evidence.note: Deterministic health assessment driven by inputs without I/O dependencies.

benefits: Trivial to test via parameterized unit tests.
Decoupled from visualization and I/O mechanisms.
costs: Caller is responsible for gathering all requisite state prior to evaluation.
failure_modes: Incomplete input metric objects lead to partial or skewed health assessments.

patterns.reuse_notes: Adopt whenever computing composite status indicators from disparate telemetry signals.

patterns.name: Swappable Client Adapter with Mock Implementation
patterns.summary: Abstracts external network service interactions behind concrete client adapters paired with local mock equivalents for zero-dependency testing.
patterns.intent: Isolate external provider network dependencies and enable fast, deterministic unit and offline test runs.
patterns.context: External API calls require network connectivity and credentials; local test suites and isolated CI environments require predictable local stubs.
forces: Testing without external service credentials or internet access
Swappable provider implementations without modifying core domain callers
patterns.solution: Provide parallel client implementations adhering to an implicit or explicit protocol, allowing runtime substitution of live clients with mock clients.
implementation_signals: Parallel classes matching method signatures (e.g. LiteLLMClient vs MockLLMClient)
Mock client generating synthetic responses without network invocation

evidence.note: Production network adapter calling external LLM proxies.
Test-double client enabling offline execution without API keys.

benefits: Guarantees CI pipeline execution without third-party network egress.
Decouples service consumers from third-party vendor libraries.
costs: Mock client must be maintained in sync with production adapter API drift.
failure_modes: Mock divergence from real network responses leading to false positives in test suites.

patterns.reuse_notes: Generalize across all infrastructure integration boundaries (e.g., git clients, artifact storage).

patterns.name: Layered Governance Service Facade
patterns.summary: Exposes a high-level application service facade orchestrating discrete domain engines for governance actions and compliance checks.
patterns.intent: Present a cohesive application interface to presentation layers (CLI/Runner) while coordinating underlying domain engines.
patterns.context: Executing a governance action involves validating compliance rules, evaluating state transitions, and persisting findings across multiple sub-systems.
forces: Prevent CLI commands from orchestrating low-level engine details
Maintain clear boundary between domain rule calculation and transaction orchestration
patterns.solution: Introduce GovernanceActionService to orchestrate ComplianceEngine and GovernanceActionEngine, handling data flow and aggregate persistence.
implementation_signals: Service class depending on multiple engine components
Higher-level business transaction methods coordinating engine executions

evidence.note: Coordinates governance action execution and compliance engine checks.
Domain engine leveraged by the service facade.

benefits: Simplifies entrypoint logic in CLI and FlowRunner.
costs: Risk of accumulating procedural 'god class' behavior if domain rules leak into the service.
failure_modes: Service methods bypassing domain engine validation for convenience.

patterns.reuse_notes: Standard application layer pattern for domain-driven Python architectures.

patterns.name: Documentation-as-Code Portal Projection
patterns.summary: Compiles structured domain outputs and governance diagrams into a versioned, static documentation portal using MkDocs and client-side visualization scripts.
patterns.intent: Project architectural health and compliance state into an accessible, searchable developer portal without requiring a dedicated dynamic web backend.
patterns.context: Architectural guidelines and live compliance metrics need to be transparent to engineering teams without running specialized hosting servers.
forces: Combining human-authored markdown with machine-generated governance dashboards
patterns.solution: Leverage MkDocs Material plugins (drawio, ezlinks, glightbox) combined with client-side JavaScript to render structured governance data directly within static documentation.
implementation_signals: Static JS files loading local JSON/reports into interactive DOM elements
Automated CI workflows publishing docs on steering sync

evidence.note: Tooling dependencies supporting static architectural portal generation.
Client-side interactive visualization script for portal dashboard metrics.
CI deployment pipeline compiling and publishing the static portal.

benefits: Zero backend maintenance for internal developer governance portal.
Documentation lives alongside source code and version control history.
costs: Data updates require portal re-build or static client-side fetching.
Limited real-time interactivity compared to dynamic single-page applications.
failure_modes: Build pipeline failure due to broken markdown links or schema mismatches in generated metrics.

patterns.reuse_notes: Ideal for enterprise architecture repositories delivering continuous architecture visibility.

anti_patterns.name: Untyped Static Dashboard Data Contract
symptoms: JavaScript visualization logic in portal/docs/static/js/dashboard.js parsing raw attributes without shared runtime JSON schema validation.
Disconnection between Python Pydantic models and client-side DOM rendering scripts.
impact: Schema changes in Python models can silently break frontend dashboard charts or status indicators without compile-time or lint-time warnings.
suggested_remediation: Export JSON Schema definitions from Pydantic models and validate emitted JSON artifacts during build steps.
Add automated end-to-end portal smoke tests asserting dashboard rendering against mock models.

anti_patterns.name: Implicit Duck-Typed Client Protocol
symptoms: LiteLLMClient and MockLLMClient implement matching methods without explicitly inheriting from an abstract base class (abc.ABC) or typing.Protocol.
impact: Signature drift between live and mock clients during refactoring can go undetected by typecheckers until runtime.
suggested_remediation: Define an explicit ClientProtocol or AbstractClient base class defining required execution methods.
Enforce type checking using mypy or pyright in CI lint workflows.

cross_cutting_concerns.implementation: OpenTelemetry API and SDK integrated via pyproject.toml to trace lifecycle runner passes and governance checks.
Centralized Ruff configuration enforcing pycodestyle, pyflakes, isort, and bugbear lint rules.

open_questions.question: How are persistence transactions coordinated between the local file system and governance action engines in failure scenarios?
open_questions.rationale: While models and action engines are defined, atomic rollback mechanisms across multi-file markdown/JSON mutations are not explicitly apparent from manifests.
